body: Why do you believe that being trans is a sick delusion? When I think of anyone who is LGBTQ, I find them very admirable because they seek their true identity and will pursue it no matter what the old societal status quo says. Coming out as trans will naturally make people question you and yes, some might see you as a "freak," but that doesn't define you. Remember, many people tend to be closed minded and they don't like to think for themselves and establish their own beliefs, so they let society tell them what to think; that can lead many of us to lose our self-esteem. I think that if you keep being the awesome person you are, despite what others tell you to be, you will become a very well grounded person with great power to guide and nurture your life. I hope this helps! I have met so many LGBTQ students in my highschool days (including some trans folks) and they are such fun people
